name: Being Of The World
overview: Scripture clearly distinguishes believers from being 'of the world,' emphasizing that followers of Christ are chosen out of the world and therefore face its opposition. The world’s love is reserved for its own, but Christians are called to reject worldly pursuits that seek self-interest rather than the interests of Jesus Christ. Moreover, friendship with the world is portrayed as enmity with God, making it impossible for believers to align themselves with worldly values without becoming adversaries of God.
